description: Set or update the webhook URL for an endpoint. Returns a signing secret that must be saved. PATs are preferred and require mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:*.

accessToken.description: Your dashboard MCP personal access token (sgl_pat_*). Can be omitted when the connection sends Authorization: Bearer sgl_pat_*

slug.description: The unique slug identifier for the endpoint

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL to receive webhook events

name: set_webhook
